characters.continuity: Taken (2008 film), Taken 2 (2012 film), Taken 3 (2014 film)
characters.summary: Lenore Mills is a civilian mother and former wife of CIA operative Bryan Mills, primarily targeted or used as leverage by criminal syndicates due to her family ties.

sources.supports: Lenore's role as Kim's mother and ex-wife of Bryan Mills in Taken.

unknowns: Specific combat training or tactical background is not emphasized in the films.

characters.continuity: 300 (2006 film), 300: Rise of an Empire (2014 film)
characters.summary: King Leonidas of Sparta is a master tactical combatant who leads 300 elite Spartan warriors in hand-to-hand and phalanx formations against overwhelming Persian invading forces.
weaknesses: human vulnerability to arrows and overwhelming numbers
limitations: Vulnerable to flanking maneuvers and missile fire in open terrain

sources.supports: Leonidas leading the Spartan army at the Battle of Thermopylae.

feats.claim: Killed numerous Persian soldiers during the initial bottleneck defense at the Hot Gates.

notableResults.note: Fought using a narrow pass to neutralize numerical superiority.
Overwhelmed after being betrayed by Ephialtes.

unknowns: Whether his tactical prowess extends beyond hoplite warfare.

characters.summary: Li Mu Bai is a legendary Wudang grandmaster swordsman possessing superhuman martial arts mastery, extraordinary agility, and profound philosophical discipline.

depictions.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon: Sword of Destiny (2016 film)

limitations: Requires intense internal focus and breath control

sources.supports: Li Mu Bai's Wudang swordsmanship and history with the Green Destiny.

characters.summary: Lucilla is a Roman noblewoman, daughter of Marcus Aurelius, who navigates court politics, subterfuge, and resistance against tyrannical emperors.
weaknesses: vulnerable to imperial decrees and imprisonment

sources.supports: Lucilla's identity as Marcus Aurelius's daughter and her resistance against Commodus.

unknowns: Direct combat prowess is non-existent; her strengths lie in influence and survival.

limitations: Relies entirely on close-quarters combat with no ranged capabilities

sources.supports: Mad Dog's role as Tama's brutal enforcer and master silat fighter.

feats.claim: Defeated multiple armed police officers simultaneously using empty-hand silat techniques.
Engaged in a brutal prolonged two-on-one fistfight against trained tactical officers.

notableResults.note: Overcame the squad leader in brutal hand-to-hand combat.

characters.continuity: The Bourne Identity (2002 film), The Bourne Supremacy (2004 film)
characters.summary: Marie Kreutz is an ordinary civilian drawn into Jason Bourne's espionage world, providing getaway driving, emotional grounding, and logistical support.
limitations: Zero combat training or physical offense

sources.supports: Marie helping Bourne escape pursuit across Europe.

feats.claim: Navigated Paris streets at high speeds to evade police pursuit while carrying Bourne.

campaignTags.claim: Pilots getaway cars expertly during high-speed chases.

unknowns: Any skills beyond civilian professions and driving.

characters.summary: Marko Hoxha is a human trafficker and enforcer in Paris who operates criminal rings before being tracked down and interrogated by Bryan Mills.
weaknesses: vulnerable to elite CIA interrogation tactics

sources.supports: Marko being identified and interrogated by Bryan Mills as a key trafficker.

feats.claim: Operated an international trafficking ring out of a Paris apartment complex.

notableResults.note: Easily overpowered and tortured for information by Mills.

unknowns: Extent of his personal combat abilities outside of criminal muscle.

weaknesses: human vulnerability to injury and dehydration

depictions.title: Mad Max 2: The Road Warrior (1981 film)

limitations: Relies heavily on ammunition and fuel availability

Engineered explosive traps and defended a moving fuel tanker against mechanized raiders.

notableResults.note: Successfully defended Furiosa's Rig against multiple assaults.

characters.summary: Maximus Decimus Meridius is a former Roman Hispaniard general turned legendary gladiator, combining supreme tactical leadership with unmatched gladiatorial weapon proficiency.
weaknesses: severe physical injuries sustained prior to combat
vulnerable to poisoned weapons and political betrayal
limitations: Human physical endurance and vulnerability to blood loss

sources.supports: Maximus's military career as general and his triumphs in the Roman Colosseum.

feats.claim: Slaughtered Germanic tribal warriors using cavalry charges and infantry tactics.
Defeated multiple gladiators simultaneously in the Colosseum, including chariot fighters and tiger handlers.

notableResults.note: Defeated the undefeated champion while refusing Commodus's execution order.
Killed Commodus in single combat despite suffering from a poisoned stab wound.

unknowns: Full extent of his tactical command range outside of Roman legion setups.
